title: Total influence and Fourier levels
statement: For a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, its total influence equals the sum over all levels $k=0,\ldots,n$ of $k$ times the total squared Fourier weight at level $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
